question: FN(τ) 经验曲线拟合参数：采用互补 Logistic 函数 FN(τ) = 1 - 1 / (1 + exp(k_fn(τ - τ_fn0))) 拟合，其中 k_fn 和 τ_fn0 需基于同一数据集回归，用于计算 dFN/dτ，反映高置信度错误分布的陡峭程度。

sources.title: Logistic function - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: A generalisation of the logistic function to multiple inputs is the softmax activation function, used in multinomial logistic regression. Another application of the logistic function is in the Rasch model, used in item response theory.
